extracted.name: Mug brownie
extracted.description: Make this mug brownie in the microwave. It takes just six minutes to make – perfect for a speedy dessert for one when you crave a sweet treat
instruction_lines: Combine all of the ingredients except the chocolate chips in a microwave-safe mug and mix well until smooth. Stir through the chocolate chips.
Microwave on high for 1 min-1 min 30 seconds until cooked through and a skewer inserted into the middle comes out clean. Serve with a scoop of vanilla ice cream on top, if you like.
